mission.title: Gathering Evidence
mission.description: Track down a band of imposter Agents and recover one of their PDAs.

npc.say: Spencer Durden said that they looked like government guys, you know in suits and stuff, except that they started attacking people for no reason. Isn't that illegal or something?
Oh, thank you! We need more people like you around the City!

phase.briefing: By now you are familiar with the unknown imposter programs who are attempting to impersonate our agents and, by attacking Zion operatives in that guise, disrupt our Truce with the humans. This must not be allowed. A group has been located in your vicinity. Destroy them all, and retrieve one of their PDA devices for analysis.

enter.say: I'm picking up very little foreign program activity inside--the imposter programs were supposed to be here, but the sensors don't indicate their signature in the area. Investigate and see if you can find any clues to their whereabouts.

talk.say: We weren't here when those thugs broke in. But Spencer Durden was--he's locked himself in the next room.

done.say: Looks like those imposter Agents have come and gone. You'll have to get into Spencer Durden's room and find out if he knows anything.

talk.say: They just busted in here, started ransacking the place. I don't know what they wanted. I ran in here and hid. They were moving around out there for a while, then I heard someone say something about looking at "gridspace 347 dot 832," and then they left. It was really weird.

done.say: It appears that the imposters left shortly before your arrival. Fortunately, this witness overheard a valuable clue--we should be able to locate that gridspace position. Leave the area and I'll update you further.

phase.briefing: We have tracked those gridspace coordinates referred to by the imposter programs. Your waypoint is being updated now. Proceed to that location and destroy them.

enter.say: This time there are strong program signals in the area--the imposter team should be here. Take them out, recover a PDA device from one of their bodies, and upload it at a hardline.

objective.text: Get the PDA from the imposter Agent

done.say: That is the item we seek. Upload it at a hardline.

objective.text: Upload the PDA at a hardline
Kill all of the imposter programs

mission.finish: This PDA should yield some clue as to the identity of these malefactors. Whoever they are, they will not last very long.
